name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing — Research, Outreach, and Pipeline
summary: B2B marketer who builds the research-to-outreach engine and then carries the number. Built an automated prospect audit workflow that scores a business's digital footprint and triggers personalized outreach, enrolling 180+ contacts, and closed six new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ in total bookings) at a performance marketing agency. 15+ years across B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments spanning account research and competitive analysis, HubSpot and CRM automation, personalized outreach and commercial copy, and working directly alongside sales on qualified meetings and pipeline.

Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners and sales teams, producing consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.

Architected and deployed a complete marketing-automation system of 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, lead qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, and long-term nurture and reactivation.
Conduct competitor research, keyword gap analyses, and technical audits of client and prospect digital presence, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, covering contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Run discovery and onboarding for a portfolio of service-based businesses, surfacing client goals, objectives, and market challenges as the basis for the commercial recommendation.
Draft clean, specific direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
